title: Create and import scope keys
responsibility: Create and rotate scope data and index keys, commit to them, import them as non-extractable keys, and derive opaque object ids.

inputs.name: newScopeKeys.rotating
inputs.description: Current scope keys for a rotation. Omit to create a scope at epoch zero.

inputs.name: scopeCommitment.raw
inputs.description: Raw scope keys and epoch to bind to a commitment.

inputs.name: sealedScopeKeys.raw
inputs.description: Raw scope key bytes to import and verify.

inputs.name: sealedObjectId.keys
inputs.description: Scope index key used to derive a stable object identifier.

inputs.name: sealedObjectId.kind
inputs.description: Object kind used to distinguish identifiers across object types.

inputs.name: sealedObjectId.localId
inputs.description: Local identifier of the object within its kind.

inputs.name: scopeName.keys
inputs.description: Keys supplying the scope identifier to encode.

outputs.name: newScopeKeys
outputs.description: Raw keys for a fresh scope or a new epoch with the scope identifier and index key preserved.

outputs.name: scopeCommitment
outputs.description: Digest binding the scope identifier, epoch, and key bytes.

outputs.name: sealedScopeKeys
outputs.description: Non-extractable scope keys and the corresponding commitment.

outputs.name: sealedObjectId
outputs.description: Opaque identifier for the object within its scope.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The key sizes or epoch are invalid, or an object kind contains a NUL separator.
